title: Private equity secondary market — discount narrowing accelerates
content: European secondary-market discounts to NAV have compressed from ~14% in 2025-Q3 to ~6% in 2026-Q1. Drivers: improved cost-of-capital outlook and a stronger flow of supply from over-allocated institutional sellers. For clients above their IPS PE target, this is the most attractive moment for tactical secondary sales we have seen since 2023. Recommended approach: discuss at next IPS review rather than pre-empting; the window is unlikely to close before Q3.
